svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 08 · San Diego · 07/12 Tide Pools (Common)
svg.desc: Low tide opens little windows in the rock. Anemones, a crab, a star. Look, do not touch. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
